Calcul global sur tout le domaine AROME: Global computation over the whole AROME domain (land and a 106 km coastal strip) every 6 hours, at each main run: 00Z, 06Z, 12Z, 18Z; secondary runs are not used. The map is calibrated once and for all by the administrator: it does not change with the calibration of places. Outside the domain, or at sea beyond the coastal strip, a place goes through the queue.

Carte globale du seeing de la nuit, dépl: Global night seeing map, draggable and zoomable
Ce site est calibré par l'administrateur: This site is calibrated by the administrator: you see the results (curves, Cn², history, correlation, calibration quality), but the calibration tools (CSV import, K settings, auto calibration) only work on your personal places.
Clique sur la carte ou saisis des coordo: Click on the map or enter valid GPS coordinates.
Clique sur la carte ou saisis les coordo: Click on the map or enter GPS coordinates (decimal degrees: 44.1234 and 5.6789, or degrees minutes seconds: 44°07'24" N and 5°40'44" E).
Coche une ou plusieurs variables à droit: Tick one or more variables on the right.

Les K des sites publics ne sont visibles: The K of public sites are visible to the administrator only; everyone sees the K of their own places.
Les mesures partagées aident à caler les: Shared measurements help calibrate the K of nearby places.
Les valeurs absolues seront bientôt disp: Absolute values will soon be available, after the global calibration.

Seeing V2bd au lieu, panneau Cn², histor: Seeing V2bd at the place, Cn² panel, history and correlation with your measurements, with the K in use for this place. K are set in the Calibrate tab.
Seeing V2bd dans chaque direction, de 19: Seeing V2bd in every direction, from 19:00 to 05:00 UTC, down to 5° elevation. Computed from the global run, by default with your place's calibration: changing the calibration or the time is instant and uses no quota.
Seeing V2bd sur tout le domaine AROME (F: Seeing V2bd over the whole AROME domain (France, British Isles, Iberian Peninsula, Benelux, Germany, Alps, Italy), recomputed every 6 hours, at each AROME main run (00Z, 06Z, 12Z, 18Z). On the domain view, click anywhere in a zone (France, United Kingdom…) to zoom on it; once zoomed, hover the map to read a grid cell and click to create a place.
Seeing calculé à partir des prévisions A: Seeing computed from AROME forecasts (Météo-France), by integrating the Cn² profile with the GmMC method (Cuevas 2024), then calibrated on seeing monitor measurements. Details will come in the tutorial.
Ses lieux, ses mesures, ses K ; consulte: Own places, measurements and K; views public and shared sites.
Tes lieux personnels : historique des pr: Your personal places: forecast and measurement history, correlation and Cn² panel. You can also view public sites and places shared by the community (read only, K confidential).
Tes mesures améliorent les prévisions :: Your measurements improve the forecasts: they calibrate the coefficients of your place and, if you share them, those of nearby places.
Tu peux exporter toutes tes données ou s: You can export all your data or delete your account at any time.
Un compte est nécessaire pour enregistre: An account is needed to save places, import measurements, set K and compute a fisheye. Without an account you can view the map and shared places.
